subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A3973/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2610271100  C) 2610281700  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3947/26 (260858 EUECYIYN OCT 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4826/26 (270757 EUECYIYN OCT 2026). 
REF (C) TURKISH NOTAM A4765/26 (211332 EUECYIYN OCT 2026). 
REFERENCE IS MADE TO THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4826/26 
LTAAYNYX IN ORDER TO STATE THAT THE ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY 
BETWEEN POINTS 404500N0261000E AND 360500N0300000E HAS BEEN 
ESTABLISHED BY ICAO REGIONAL AGREEMENTS (REACHED IN THE SECOND 
MIDDLE EAST REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATION MEETING, ISTANBUL 1950 AND 
SUBSEQUENTLY APPROVED BY THE ICAO COUNCIL ON 14 DEC 1950, DOC 7055 
MID/2-RAC) WITH THE PARTICIPATION AND APPROVAL OF TURKIYE AND IN FEB 
1958, (DOC 7870, EUM/IV) AND CONSEQUENTLY IS FOUNDED ON THE FIRMEST 
POSSIBLE LEGAL BASIS AS NOTED IN OUR A1709/07 LGGGYNYX NOTAM. 
FURTHERMORE THE SAID ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY WAS DEPICTED ON 
CHART NUMBER 7 ATTACHED TO THE REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AGREEMENT 
WHICH WAS REACHED IN THE THIRD REGIONAL AIR NAVIGATIONAL CONFERENCE 
(PARIS 1952) AND SUBSEQUENTLY APPROVED BY THE ICAO COUNCIL ON 23 
JUNE 1952. 
ACCORDINGLY, GREECE HAS BEEN ASIGNED RESPONSIBILITY FOR ALL ATM 
SERVICES AND ICAO PURPOSES AS WELL AS FOR SAR END PART 1 OF 2
A3973/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2610271100  C) 2610281700  E) WITHIN 
ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR AND IS THE ONLY COMPETENT THEREIN. 
THEREFORE, THE DEFINITION OF EXERCISE OR SAR AREAS WITH REFERENCE 
TO THE AFOREMENTIONED ATHINAI/ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY, AS THIS 
BOUNDARY IS CLEARLY DEPICTED IN THE ICAO AERONAUTICAL CHARTS, IS A 
JUSTIFIED AND RIGHTFUL PRACTICE NOT LEAVING SPACE FOR MISLEADING OR 
MISINTERPRETATIONS. 
ON THE AFOREMENTIONED BASIS THE REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3947/26 (260858 
EUECYIYN OCT 2026), STATED THAT WITH REFERENCE TO REF (C) TURKISH 
NOTAM A4765/26 (211332 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) A PART OF THE AREA AS 
DESCRIBED IN REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3947/26, STRICTLY LIES WITHIN 
ATHINAI FIR WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS 
ACCORDING TO ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION 
SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP). 
CONSEQUENTLY, THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A4826/26 (270757 EUECYIYN OCT 
2026) HAS NO GROUND, CANNOT PRODUCE ANY INTERNATIONALLY LEGAL EFFECT 
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR / HELLAS UIR AND IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR IS 
THE REF (A) A3947/26, ISSUED BY GREECE. END PART 2 OF 2
